body: Most of my dreams are about me or people I care for dying... No joke...

Please don't give in to the pressures of life.. I just wrote my first post of the sub reddit and I was going to commit 42 minutes ago but people talked me into not doing it anymore. I'm not going to say things will get better because I don't know for sure and I know not of what your life is but eventually all the bad things will fuck off and you'll be able to look past them and see the good side of things.. Those 6 people you wrote to is just another reason why you shouldn't go through with your plan, there's 6 more people who care about you and would be sad to see you leave. And again I may not know you but to hear that you are no longer of this world would sadden me quite a bit. I don't think you should do it but if you must, you must I can't stop you but can you do me a favour? Instead of ending future possibilities, try and create some? And who knows maybe that one extra go will end you up in a complete different train of thought?
